boundaries.why: a program that only draws random bytes or compares tags names no backend library (spec section 2.2), nor does the signing vocabulary every curve shares, nor the free factories (from_secret, from_bytes, from_key, generate) every AEAD's header includes, nor the AEAD and box contracts with their free seal and open, which every AEAD's and box's header includes; the detail headers these include are in the boundary too, since the rule is not transitive
